title: FEATURE: Specific 3GPP Mission Critical XML
description: FEATURE: Specific 3GPP Mission Critical XML have been included to the XML dissector list. Additionally, Mikey "application/mikey" mime type has been included in the MIKEY dissector options.

@andoni.diazdecerio Thanks for your contribution. Can you please amend the commit message according to our [guidelines](https://wiki.wireshark.org/Development/SubmittingPatches#writing-a-good-commit-message).

Would be even better to split this up into two MR (one for MIKEY and one for XML).

Thanks for your support @uhei ... newbie errors I guess

I have already split this change in two different MR

- https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/6740
- https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/6741

Thank you very much
